t: A low-cost Linux computer built on an eight-core RISC-V chip.
steps: Buy the board from the Orange Pi official links on Amazon or the Orange Pi Xunlong Store on AliExpress. Pick the 2, 4, or 8 GB version.
Get a 5 volt 5 amp USB-C power supply and a microSD card.
Download the Ubuntu image from the official Orange Pi download page. Armbian images are another choice.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and connect power, an HDMI screen, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Follow the setup steps in the Orange Pi RV2 user manual.
Try the 26-pin header examples in the manual to blink an LED.
Add an NVMe SSD to the lower M.2 slot later for faster storage.
